title: Keep a cached shipment from changing under its rate

blocks.text: The quoting service caches each shipping rate under the `Shipment` it was quoted for. Since a new client went live, the cache keeps growing while its hit rate falls, and support has a ticket about a shipment that was quoted twice at different prices. The new client builds each shipment from one `HashMap` of parcels, which it keeps filling for the next request.

items: the compact constructor of `Shipment`: once built, a shipment keeps the parcels it was given, whatever later happens to the caller's map or to the map `parcels()` returns;
`withParcel(id, grams)`: a new shipment with one more parcel, leaving this one as it is.

blocks.text: When you're done, a cached shipment is found again however the code around it treats its maps. About four lines in total.

cases.says: two shipments built separately from the same carrier and parcels find the same cached rate, and a different weight does not
withParcel returns a shipment with the extra parcel, and the original keeps its parcels and its cached rate
when the caller changes the map it built a shipment from, the shipment keeps its parcels and its rate is still found
code that removes a parcel from the map parcels() returns does not change the shipment, and its rate is still found

origin.section: A Record Is Only Shallowly Immutable: a List Component Can Change Under a Map Key

concepts: A record is only shallowly immutable: a mutable collection component changed after the record became a map key changes its hash and loses the entry, unless the compact constructor stores an unmodifiable copy rather than a view.
